# Psalm 74 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** A contemplative poem of Asaph. God, why have you thrown us away — and for good? Why is your anger blazing against the flock you're supposed to be shepherding?

**2** Remember the people you chose long ago, the nation you rescued to be your very own! Remember Mount Zion, where you made your home.

**3** Walk through these endless ruins and see — the enemy has demolished everything in your holy place.

**4** Your enemies roared like beasts right in the middle of where we used to worship you; they put up their own flags in place of yours.

**5** They hacked away like lumberjacks chopping through a forest.

**6** They smashed all the beautiful carved work with their axes and hammers.

**7** They set your sanctuary on fire and tore the place where your name lives down to the ground.

**8** They told themselves, 'We'll wipe them all out!' They burned every place of worship throughout the land.

**9** We see none of our sacred signs anymore. There's no prophet left, and nobody knows how long this will last.

**10** How long, God, will the enemy insult you? Will they trash-talk your name forever?

**11** Why are you holding your hand back? Pull your right hand out and finish them!

**12** But God, you have been my king from the very beginning, bringing salvation to the world.

**13** You split the sea open with your power and smashed the heads of the sea monsters in the waters.

**14** You crushed the heads of Leviathan and fed him to the creatures of the desert.

**15** You opened up springs and streams; you also dried up rivers that never stopped flowing.

**16** The day belongs to you, and so does the night. You set the sun and moon in their places.

**17** You drew every boundary on the earth. You created summer and winter.

**18** LORD, remember this: the enemy has mocked you, and foolish people have disrespected your name.

**19** Don't hand over your helpless dove to these wild animals! Don't forget your suffering people forever.

**20** Remember your covenant! Every dark corner of this land has become a hideout for violence.

**21** Don't let the oppressed slink away in humiliation. Let the poor and needy shout your name with praise!

**22** Rise up, God! Fight for your own cause! Remember how these fools mock you all day long.

**23** Don't ignore the shouting of your enemies — the constant roar of those who defy you never stops.

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **74:1**: This is the raw cry of a community watching their sacred space burn. There's no softening of the accusation — 'Why have you thrown us away?'

- **74:9**: 'No prophet, no sign, no one knows how long' — three devastating losses. Without divine communication, the suffering feels meaningless.

- **74:12-17**: Right in the middle of the darkest lament, the psalmist pivots to praising God's power over chaos. It's not denial — it's choosing to remember what God has already proven he can do.

— PNEUMA
